blocks.content: Consistent revision of core exam points is the most effective strategy for competitive exam success.

items: Direct questions from summary notes frequently appear in objective preliminary examinations.
Pay close attention to specific definitions, exceptions to rules, and numerical values.
Avoid negative marking by attempting questions with high conceptual clarity.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Prioritize high-weightage topics and recurring questions from previous year papers.
Focus on core concepts, formulas, definitions, and key historical or scientific dates.
Systematic revision of summary points significantly improves speed and accuracy.
Elimination techniques and strategic time management are essential for scoring high.
